name: betang-kemenag
description: SI BETANG - Sistem Informasi Basis Elektronik Tata Arsip dan Naskah Gabungan Kementerian Agama Kabupaten Barito Utara

scripts.dev: infisical run --env=dev --path=/betang-kemenag -- concurrently -n "Backend,FrontEnd" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:backend:raw" "npm run dev:frontend:raw"
scripts.dev:backend:go: infisical run --env=dev --path=/betang-kemenag -- cd backend && go run ./cmd/api
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && go mod download && go mod tidy
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && go mod download && go mod tidy
